items.title: Duncan Robinson through seven games:
items.author: Omari Sankofa II
items.body_excerpt:
Duncan Robinson through seven games:

17.9 points, 2.3 assists, 2 steals, 1.3 turnovers, 44.6% overall, 45.2% from 3 (8.9 attempts), 88.5% at the line (3.7 attempts).

His career-high in free throws per game is 1.4. It’s been a priority for him to get to the line more.
